title: organizations: per-org seed replay errors are logged at info, so a new org that gets no seed rows leaves no warning
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (mailbox #32588, 6966984093, item 3), from the seat's L2 on PR #35065 (#34940).

## What happens
`packages/plugins/organizations/src/organizations-plugin.ts` reports `per-org seed replay …: +0 inserted, 0 updated, N error(s)` at **info**. A new organization that gets **no** seed rows (for example, no standard price book) leaves no warning in the server log, so an operator cannot see why the org starts empty.

## Done when
- A replay with `N > 0` errors logs at **warn**, naming the object, the first error, and the org id.
- A pin covers a replay with one refused row raising a warn line.

Grade: **p2 · domain:server**. Theme: install, upgrade and uninstall reliability (new org onboarding, the #34940 family). It is a one-line level change plus a pin, with no customer named.
